meinestadt_categories.title: Meinestadt – categories
meinestadt_categories.description: Meinestadt only. Pick one or more categories. Leave empty to scrape the default search (everything).

arbeitsagentur_categories.title: Arbeitsagentur – categories
arbeitsagentur_categories.description: Arbeitsagentur only. Pick one or more broad categories (each bundles several occupational fields / Berufsfelder). Leave empty to use the keyword/location below, or to scrape everything.

arbeitsagentur_keyword.title: Arbeitsagentur – keyword (optional)
arbeitsagentur_keyword.description: Arbeitsagentur only. Free-text search (the 'was' field), e.g. a job title or skill. Combined with the selected categories.

arbeitsagentur_location.title: Arbeitsagentur – location (optional)
arbeitsagentur_location.description: Arbeitsagentur only. Place name or postal code (the 'wo' field) to restrict results geographically.

arbeitsagentur_radius.title: Arbeitsagentur – radius (km)
arbeitsagentur_radius.description: Arbeitsagentur only. Search radius in km around the location (defaults to 25 when a location is set).

arbeitsagentur_listing_limit.title: Arbeitsagentur – listing limit
arbeitsagentur_listing_limit.description: Arbeitsagentur only. Optional cap on how many listings (detail fetches) to process per category. Bounds cost for big categories. Leave empty for no cap.

output_mode.title: Output mode
output_mode.description: combined = all results in one dataset/CSV. per_category = one CSV file per category (in the run key-value store). per_subgroup = one CSV file per subgroup (HZZ; falls back to per_category for Meinestadt).

email_to.title: Email results to
email_to.description: Optional. If set, the run emails download links to the generated CSV file(s) to this address (comma-separate for multiple). Leave empty to skip email.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to scrape (per category/subgroup).

results_per_page.title: Results per page (HZZ / Arbeitsagentur)
results_per_page.description: Listing page size. HZZ: 10/25/50/75. Arbeitsagentur: up to 100 (clamped). Ignored by Meinestadt.

company_limit.title: Company limit
company_limit.description: Optional cap on distinct companies collected (per category/subgroup). Leave empty for no limit.

country.title: Country override
country.description: Value written to the 'country' field. Defaults to Hrvatska (HZZ) / Germany (Meinestadt, Arbeitsagentur).

category.title: Category (legacy, single)
category.description: Backward-compatible single category key. Prefer the multi-select fields above. Merged with them if set.

group.title: Group (legacy, single, HZZ only)
group.description: Backward-compatible single subgroup label. Prefer the multi-select fields above.
